claim_text: Pacific Blue Cross says it is dealing with a "cyber incident" that disrupted some of its systems
summary: Pacific Blue Cross says on its own website that a "cyber incident" has affected some of its systems. CBC News and Vista Radio report the same.
detail: The company has not said what the incident was: it has not called it an attack, named a cause or said whether anyone got into its systems.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Pacific Blue Cross notice, Nov 27: "We have experienced a cyber incident which has affected some of our systems." CBC (carried by Yahoo) and My Prince George Now report the same words.
notes: Was Reported on the two outlets until the company's own notice could be read.

claim_text: Pacific Blue Cross's website and contact centre are down, and members cannot reach some services
summary: Members cannot reach some Pacific Blue Cross services, including its website and contact centre, according to CBC News and Vista Radio. No restoration had been announced as of Nov 27.
detail: The company's notice says its website is temporarily unavailable; the contact centre being down rests on CBC. On Nov 28 the site still served only that notice, with an HTTP 503 status.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: Pacific Blue Cross notice: "Our website is temporarily unavailable". CBC: members cannot access "certain services, including its website and contact centre".

claim_text: Pacific Blue Cross first became aware of the disruption early on Wednesday Nov 25
summary: The company says it first became aware of the disruption early on Wednesday, Nov 25, 2026.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: CBC: the company says it "first became aware of the disruption early Wednesday, Nov. 25."

claim_text: Pacific Blue Cross says it has contained the incident and is restoring services with outside specialists
summary: The company says it has taken steps to contain the incident and is working to restore services securely, with external specialists investigating how far it reached.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Pacific Blue Cross notice: "We have taken steps to contain the incident and we are working to securely restore services. We are working with external specialists to investigate the extent of the incident."
notes: Was Reported on CBC and Vista Radio until the company's own notice could be read.

claim_text: Pacific Blue Cross has not said what caused the incident or whether members' personal information was affected
summary: The company has not said what caused the incident, whether members' personal information was compromised or how many members are directly affected.
detail: No credible outlet has reported a claim by any group to be behind it.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: CBC: the company has not said what caused it or "whether members' personal information has been compromised", nor "how many members are directly affected". My Prince George Now does not report a cause or any data exposure.

claim_text: Members are asked to keep claims and receipts until services are restored
summary: Pacific Blue Cross asks members to hold on to their claims, receipts and plan administration requests; it says they will be processed once services are restored.
detail: CBC also reports that emergency travel claims go to the company's travel assistance line.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Pacific Blue Cross notice: "we are asking members to hold claims and receipts as well as any plan administrative needs, which will be processed when we resume normal services."
notes: Was Reported on CBC and Vista Radio until the company's own notice could be read.

claim_text: A member told Vista Radio they had to pay cash for prescriptions
summary: One claimant told Vista Radio they learned of the incident when they had to pay for prescriptions out of their own pocket because the Pacific Blue Cross system was down.
detail: One person's account; how widely pharmacy claims are affected has not been reported.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: My Prince George Now: "When I went to pick up my prescriptions I had to pay cash, because (Pacific) Blue Cross System is shut down."

claim_text: Pacific Blue Cross serves about 1.7 million British Columbians
summary: Pacific Blue Cross, a not-for-profit health benefits provider based in Burnaby, serves about 1.7 million people in British Columbia, according to CBC.
detail: Wikipedia describes it as a not-for-profit health insurance provider with about one in three British Columbians enrolled in its plans.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: CBC: Pacific Blue Cross "serves approximately 1.7 million British Columbians". Wikipedia: "not-for-profit health insurance provider" headquartered in Burnaby.

claim_text: Pacific Blue Cross says members' coverage has not changed
summary: Pacific Blue Cross says members' coverage has not changed during the disruption; only claims and plan requests are on hold until services resume.
detail: Its notice says emergency travel claims go to its travel assistance provider, Medi-Assist, and that Pacific Blue Cross pays for collect calls to it.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Pacific Blue Cross notice, last updated Nov 27, 5:21 PM PT: "Member coverage has not changed."
